candidates.why: dwg_block_control() (called at out_dxf.c:3311) does a shallow struct copy `dwg->block_control = *obj->tio.object->tio.BLOCK_CONTROL` (dwg.c:947; same pattern at decode.c:5743), so dwg->block_control.entries aliases the BLOCK_CONTROL object's entries array. That array is freed by dwg_free_BLOCK_CONTROL (free.c:750) when the source object is freed. If the BLOCK_CONTROL object is freed while dwg->block_control still holds the stale copy, the loop at out_dxf.c:3355-3361 dereferences freed memory (dwg->block_control.entries[i] at 3359/3361).

Same aliasing as above: the NULL-check `if (!dwg->block_control.entries)` at 3357 and the loop bound `dwg->block_control.num_entries` at 3355 read the shallow-copied struct (dwg.c:947) whose backing entries array may have been freed via dwg_free_BLOCK_CONTROL (free.c:750).
